model_or_product: Sperrin Fuzz Box; related Sperrin musical-electronics equipment
evidence_summary: The Sperrin Fuzz Box was developed and sold by David Sperrin in Southport, England, and was advertised repeatedly in the UK music press during 1966. Family testimony confirms David and his wife Beryl assembled and shipped the fuzz boxes from their home. Sperrin also built and supplied amplifiers and other musical-electronics equipment, establishing an independent builder operation rather than a mere marketed label.
